# Generated VoltEdge reliability cases

**IMPLEMENTED (local evaluation fixtures).** `reliability_v1.json` is generated by
`python3 scripts/generate_golden.py --write`. Verify reproducibility with
`python3 scripts/generate_golden.py --check` and evaluate with
`python3 scripts/eval.py --report docs/EVAL_REPORT.md`.

All records and copy are fictional VoltEdge data. Expectations are specified in
the templates independently of the audit implementation. Cases include clean
controls, mismatches, missing/conflicting/scoped evidence, conversions,
approximation without tolerance, currency/locale formats, configured rules,
instruction-like content, and explicit word-number challenge cases.

The original 12 `golden-v1` examples remain in the parent directory. This bundle's
oracle covers the bounded local library, not image analysis, model accuracy,
API integration, durable persistence, or legal compliance. See the measured report
for exact denominators and limitations.
